baseline.code_revision: repair source b2ca094aed4eccf266d90fff4adedb826081af22; audit source hashes recorded at run time
baseline.equivalence_test: Initial old heads equal Reader exactly on all sampled inputs; positive monotonic compression has identical Top-5.

core_invariants: Observation only; no fitting/backward/optimizer, Generator or evaluation passes.
All online heads use target-free base/semantic/scalar states; train answer strings are diagnosis-only.
Evaluation hashes are exclusion-only; no 100-case question/passages/answers/Silver inputs are loaded.
Previous heads saw all these cases; prospective split is not an independent evaluation of those heads.
Missing cache/index stops; no model/data download or index construction.
Full raw text and detached values use exchange only; compact GitHub files remain <=1 MiB.
No support-quality conclusion before independent blinded review.

composition.merge_rule: One shared extraction, independent frozen-head replays; never feed diagnosis to ranking or training.

validation.baseline_equivalence: all same-input initial scores and compressed Top-5 match Reader

reproducibility.dataset_identity: existing nq_open/train first512; same434 mixed weak cohort, fixed32 sample, exact Wiki-DPR Top50 identities
reproducibility.environment: reuse active collaborator Python/Torch/Transformers/datasets/FAISS; all HF operations offline

limitations: Observation exporter, not a new quantum architecture or trained candidate.
Weak substring counts are not support accuracy.
Blinded model/human review will remain diagnostic Silver unless independently validated.
No full-data utility or quantum-advantage claim.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Independent blinded support of train-only high-score weak negatives and low-score weak positives, plus matched nonpositive correction controls; no utility escalation before this evidence.

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: two original witnesses +15 hashed prospective-training +15 prospective-validation cases; fixed seed20261009; no score/outcome selection
trace_contract.target_boundary: Train answers for weak diagnosis only; eval question hashes exclusion only; no labels in head input; blinded review omits weak labels/scores/methods.
producer_owned_lineage: cached source question/candidate text hash -> Reader -> frozen checkpoint head -> deterministic selection -> diagnosis
source NPZ checkpoint tensor keys -> detached reopened output tensors
readiness_checks: exact initial and monotonic selection null

trace_readiness.structural_validation: Project-owned v2 validator reopens 32-case fixture and enforces source identity, canonical stage order and method/field coverage; 24 new tests pass.
trace_readiness.semantic_validation: Full detached NPZ opens and hashes; complete 32x50 base/pooling/scalar/head values replay; two hidden-token masks/pooling slices and producer raw input hashes pass. See pinned local/server fixture paths and hashes.
trace_readiness.replay_test: Initial null and positive monotonic compression match baseline on all 32 cases; existing final head replays pass on same inputs; 36 combined tests on local/server.
